body:
[`normal_font_size`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/b8e452322411e55fc31f23c05ae2eb95ceff6c35/doc/classes/RichTextLabel.xml#L997-L999) is not a property, it's a _theme item_. We don't currently generate `StringName`s for theme items, probably because they weren't registered in ClassDB when the generated `StringName`s were added.

Also, I'm not sure how much these names need to be used in a hot path, since I don't think you are supposed to modify the theme items every frame. So it's likely that adding generated `StringName`s for them will just add unnecessary bloat.
